name: browser_navigate
description: Open a page in the built-in browser, the panel on the right of the app where the user's own logins live. Returns a snapshot of the screen: text, and the elements you can use, each with a [number].

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

url.description: An address (https://example.com or example.com), a local file path, words to search on Google, or back, forward, reload

name: browser_snapshot
description: Describe what the page in the built-in browser shows right now: text, and the elements you can use with their [numbers]. Only what is on screen, unless full is true.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

full.description: Cover the whole page, not only the visible part

name: browser_click
description: Click in the built-in browser like a person with a mouse: pass ref, the [number] from the latest snapshot, or x and y in page pixels read from a screenshot. Returns the new snapshot.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

x.description: Horizontal position in page pixels, instead of ref

y.description: Vertical position in page pixels, instead of ref

name: browser_type
description: Type into a field in the built-in browser: clicks field ref, replaces its text and types like a keyboard. submit true presses Enter after. Without ref it types where the focus is.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

clear.description: false keeps the text already in the field and adds to it

name: browser_select
description: Choose an option of a dropdown list (a select element) in the built-in browser by its visible text or value. Menus built from other elements are opened with a click and chosen with a click.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

ref.description: The list [number] from the latest snapshot

name: browser_press
description: Press a key or a combination in the built-in browser: Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, Delete, Space, ArrowDown, PageDown, Home, End, Control+A, Shift+Tab and so on.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

name: browser_scroll
description: Scroll the page in the built-in browser down or up by a share of the screen, or bring element ref into view. Returns the new snapshot.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

ref.description: Scroll this element into view instead

name: browser_screenshot
description: Look at the page in the built-in browser yourself: returns a picture of the screen, or of the page from the top with full_page. Use it when layout, images, colors, charts or the look of a site you build matter, or when the snapshot is not enough.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

full_page.description: The page from the top, up to four screens tall

name: browser_read
description: Read a frozen HTML-derived text snapshot, with headings, lists and links. Not computed visibility: may include hidden text and omit form values, shadow roots and iframes. Long pages come in parts; continue with tabId, readId and start.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

start.description: UTF-16 code-unit offset (not bytes) in the frozen read snapshot

readId.description: Read identity from the first part; required for continuation. Start at 0 without readId to refresh.

name: browser_wait
description: Wait in the built-in browser until some text appears on the page, or for a number of seconds, then return the snapshot.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

seconds.description: How long to wait at most, 15 by default with text

name: browser_tabs
description: List tabs, open a new one (with url to load a page), switch or close using stable tabId from the list. Opening at the 12-tab limit fails without eviction. Browser calls are serialized across chats.

tabId.description: Stable tabId from a result or host.browser; otherwise the active tab is pinned at receipt.

pageId.description: Page identity from a snapshot. Required for input; a changed page fails without input. Re-snapshot after navigation.

url.description: For new: what to open in it

tab.description: Display position only; use tabId for switch and close
